markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged (tier 2) for high invasive probability [F1], model consensus, and drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Single dominant class; maximum risk |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%, 90% test coverage) | Single class; 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 76th OOD percentile [F6] | Typical image; all 12 regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (85%–88% similarity) [F5] | All five nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.56 contribution) pushing strongest toward invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 11) · context · Below-typical score (+0.54 contribution); immune cell fraction 0% [F3] [F10] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.51 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low benign stroma (+0.36 contribution; 20/20 AI spot check) · Validated
- **Nuclear morphometry** (regions 6, 7, 10) · context · Size variation 98th percentile [F8], shape 90th [F9], size 0th [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0) and leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions represent ductal carcinoma in situ; an InSitu contrast case (BACH_0231) shares 82% similarity, differing in duct confinement.
- Small nuclear size (34 µm², 0th percentile) reflects non-invasive proliferation, given small-cohort calibration (n=132, 24 patients, 5% ECE).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 8, 10**: Peak risk (100%) and invasion scores; confirm stromal invasion before releasing drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 6, 7, 10**: Verify 191 segmented neoplastic nuclei showing small mean size (34 µm²) yet high size variation.
3. **Regions 1, 11**: Check region 1 for duct-confined atypia (vs InSitu) and region 11 for lowest risk (68%).
